lines: Ladder: builds with the Spellblade keystone lost it when opened in the planner (the ladder data spells its id differently). It now counts in the damage and shows on the tree.

Minion skills: Added Poison, Honed Edge, Deathblow, Vicious Projectiles and the other half-strength supports now fit summons and work at half their numbers, as the game does. Added Poison and the crit supports count in the minions' damage; ailments, Marks and charges from minions are not counted yet.
Spellblade now lends attacks only increased Spell Damage, not Spell "more" lines or Boundless Mind (the game's rule since build 64).
The Siege Line rune now raises the Ballista and Totem limits by one (7 Ballistas, 11 Totems).
Item Search: new Skill gems and Support gems categories. Filter skills by class, tag and colour, supports by the skills they work with; each card has its patch history.
Build tab: the skill tooltip showed "Strikes: [object Object]"; it now shows the number of strikes.

Fixed: item lines that trigger on one named skill were never counted (Quiver of the Ninth Storm's storm burst on every Lightning Arrow hit). They now count for that skill. Checked against the game log.
Guardians: Death Sentence now counts at its grown value (25% rising to 32.5% after 10 seconds on a Guardian). Checked in the game log.

Guardians: the venom golem's 7.5% now multiplies on top of your strongest damage taken effect (it is not part of the "only the strongest counts" rule). Checked in the game log, for the golem's poison and for the hero's own.
Guardians: only one shock counts on a Guardian, so extra shock stacks (Oath of the Rolling Thunder, Living Storm) do nothing there. From one test character's fights.

Shock on Guardians now uses a Guardian life estimated from logged fights (it was hundreds of times too low on deep Ruptures, which gave far too big a shock). The Ladder's Sim DPS uses the hero's Rupture level for it.
Fixed: after the last update skill icons could show the wrong picture, or none, until the browser reloaded them.
Skill icons now come from the game's own art: the new skills (Hoarfrost Volley, Sentence of Chains, the three new Vows) and 10 older ones that had none now show an icon.
New Recent Patch tab: what each game patch changed in skills, supports, items and the passive tree, and the change history of any of them. Hover a name to see what it does now.
Item Search: every item and item mod has a Patch history you can open.
Character tab: click a skill to edit it in its own window (gem level, supports, skill bar), with Sim Supports and its patch history.
Character tab: an Action bar between your gear and idols. Click a slot to pick a skill, or drag a skill to another slot.
Removing gear, an idol or a skill no longer asks first; an Undo button (or Ctrl+Z) puts it back.
Fixed: Sim Supports showed no setups for Spark skills such as Venom Spark (their mana was counted per strike instead of per cast).
Sim: armour, shield and axe bases now count their family line.

Page languages are now Chinese, Spanish, Russian, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese and Ukrainian. Czech, Danish, Finnish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Turkish and Vietnamese are no longer offered; their old links open the English page.
Skill Scaling, Brewmaw's Brewery and the Fossil Planner are now translated in every page language. Potion, idol and runeword names stay in English, like item names.
Fixed two mistranslated sidebar lines ("No characters found", "Forget loaded characters") in the machine-translated languages.
New page languages: Dansk, Suomi, Svenska (the language button). Game names use the game's own words; the page's text is machine translation (DeepL) and in beta.
New page language: Nederlands (the language button). Game names use the game's own Dutch; the translation is in beta.

New page languages: Čeština, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Polski, Português (Brasil), Türkçe, Українська, Tiếng Việt (the language button). Game names use the game's own words; the page's text is machine translation (DeepL) and in beta.
Game data for patch 73 (from the Broken Oath public API).

Patch 73 rules: on a Guardian only your strongest damage taken effect counts; Multistrike, Afterimage and Repeat no longer lower damage when your gear or tree already repeats the skill; skills from another class cost 1.5x mana, Orbiting Hammers, Pyre of Faith and Unholy Void hold 30% of your mana (their own class about a third of that), mana leech up to 8% of your mana a second.
Attack gem levels from gear: +1 to +5 give 3% more each, past +5 still 6%.
Patch 72 rules: any cold damage chills again; minion critical strike lines (Soul Harvest, Bone Sovereign) now count.
These follow the developer's patch notes and game data; not yet checked in game.
